name: Rick Jackson
summary:
Richard Lee Jackson (born March 16, 1954) is an American billionaire entrepreneur and former political candidate. He is the founder and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Jackson Healthcare, a healthcare staffing and services company headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia. 
After defeating lieutenant governor of Georgia Burt Jones in the Republican primary runoff, he became the Republican nominee in the 2026 Georgia gubernatorial election and faced Democratic nominee Keisha Lance Bottoms in the general election.
